Practical note for anyone flying with an animal
It is easier with this note
Travelers need to know the basics before they arrive at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk staff will help you prepare papers, check carrier details, and keep the process calm for you and your pet. <<FACT F082>> Bring any required records in clear order, and make sure the animal is comfortable, secure, and ready for a smooth handover. Trained staff give each animal patient attention, and the senior coordinator reviews daily service decisions so the desk can keep things steady for travelers.

Please read your booking notes carefully and follow every instruction before you come to the airport. If you are unsure about a document, a carrier, or the check-in flow, the desk can point you in the right direction.
